document.behavior: the live Document facade of the window; repeated reads hand back one and the same object (T20 identity through the unique wrap entry)

destroy.behavior: forwards to the native WindowHandle.destroy: eagerly destroys the document, idempotent
forwards to the native DocumentHandle.destroy: eagerly destroys the document, idempotent

construction.rule: Window and Document can only be constructed from a genuine native handle of the matching type; every other argument throws TypeError
construction.Window: requires a native WindowHandle (has document() and destroy())
construction.Document: requires a native DocumentHandle (has appendChild() and destroy())

conversionEntry.ctx.wrap: the single native handle -> facade wrapper conversion entry; all wrapper production goes through it; identity mirrors the native per-document weak cache

registry.install: each capability extension exports one named install(ctx); extensions/index.js calls it exactly once at facade initialization and skips modules that do not export install yet

lifecycle.destroyForwards: Window.destroy and Document.destroy reach the native handle
lifecycle.accessorAfterDestroy: window.document keeps returning the same object after destroy
